note: LEADS.md Part U U2, TEST_LEDGER.md T-1072: STRATA_REDUCE_F32=1 (f32 accumulators and f32 exp / sqrt / divide instead of f64 in the legacy silu_kernel, gdn_l2_kernel, gdn_out_norm_kernel, ple gnorm / gate / bf16_gemv and qsa indexer_key_append kernels; include/strata/kernels/reduce_f32.hpp). CODED, NOT RUN. RUN THIS ONLY AFTER the dispatch census (lead U3, branch lead/U3) shows at least one of those kernels launched by the preset: under --native (the daily preset) layer.cpp takes the native f32 kernels instead (native_gdn_*, native_qsa_indexer_*, native_ple_postops, native_bf16), so on a static reading every kernel of this switch is bypassed, the arm is the base (INERT) and an A/B proves nothing (a flat result means INERT, not no gain). If the census names a kernel the A/B needs the build of the same binary twice (build-win), prompt tok/s at short / long3k / long. The switch is lossy by class (last-bit differences, tools/pancake/reduce_f32_model.py): the text may differ (drift_check true reports it), and any gain needs tools/pancake/quality_gate.py before a default. The device parity of the formulas (all 2^32 f32 inputs for silu, rows for the norms) is the probe tools/pancake/probes/reduce_f32_parity.hip.cpp, run it first.
